verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਵੈਸ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਰਾਜਪੂਤ ਰਾਵਤ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe vais vakhaaneean raajapoot raavat veechaaree|

en.bdb: Among vais rajput and many others have been considered.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂਅਰ ਗਉੜ ਪਵਾਰ ਲਖ ਮਲਣ ਹਾਸ ਚਉਹਾਣ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: tooar gauR pavaar lakh malan haas chauhaan chitaaree|

en.bdb: Many, such as Tuars, Gaur, Pavar, Malan, Has, Chauhan etc., are remembered.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਛਵਾਹੇ ਰਾਠਉੜ ਲਖ ਰਾਣੇ ਰਾਇ ਭੂਮੀਏ ਭਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kachhavaahe raaThauR lakh raane rai bhoome'ee bhaaree|

en.bdb: Kachavahe, Rauthor etc. many kings and landlords have passed away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਘ ਬਘੇਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਬਲਵੰਡ ਲਖ ਬੁੰਦੇਲੇ ਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: baagh baghele ketaRe balava(n)dd lakh bu(n)dhele kaaree|

en.bdb: Bagh, Baghele and many other powerful Bundele have existed earlier.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਭੁਰਟੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) hee bhuraTe'ee dharabaaraa(n) a(n)dhar dharabaaree|

en.bdb: Many were Bhats who were courtiers in the bigger courts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਗਣੀ ਭਦਉੜੀਏ ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਵਡੇ ਇਤਬਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe ganee bhadhauRe'e dhes dhes vadde itabaaree|

en.bdb: Many talented persons belonging to Bhadaurie were acknowledged in the country and abroad.
But they all perished in their ego, which they could not decimate.
